name: Dynamic Interface Patcher
author: Linux port of Cutleast's Dynamic Interface Patcher
description:
(Apply DIP patches (e.g. Norden/Oathvein/Vel'dun RaceMenu DIP) to UI mods such as RaceMenu.
  Native Linux port of DIP 2.1.5 - no Wine needed.
  The patched SWFs are installed as a new mod above the patch.

  This Plugin was built with Original DIP and Claude to intergrate to Linux)

settings.label: Before launching the game, re-patch DIP outputs whose patch or original mod changed
settings.description: Checks every enabled '(DIP Output)' mod against its patch and the original mod the game uses (a quick hash check), and re-patches only when something changed. Never blocks the launch; problems are written to the log.

settings.label: Java executable (empty = auto-detect; only needed for JSON patches)
FFDec version (26.4.0 default; 18.5.0 = what DIP.exe bundles)
settings.description: Version to look for or download. Use 18.5.0 if a JSON patch made for DIP.exe stops applying.

settings.label: If FFDec 26.4.0 fails on a file, patch it again with 18.5.0
settings.description: Retries a SWF from its original with FFDec 18.5.0 (what DIP.exe uses) when the chosen FFDec errors or leaves patch filters unmatched, and keeps the better result. Uses an installed FFDec 18.5.0 (or the one inside a Windows DIP mod) if present, otherwise downloads it the first time it is needed. Also used when the chosen FFDec cannot be found or downloaded.

settings.label: FFDec jar or ffdec_<version>.zip (empty = automatic; overrides the version)
Download FFDec automatically if it is missing (the chosen version, and 18.5.0 for the fallback)
settings.description: Turn off to never use the network; then install FFDec yourself with the FFDec jar or zip setting.

settings.label: Repack BSA instead of loose files by default (experimental)
